name: Developer Tools & Technical Products

designIntent.primaryGoal: Make complex capabilities discoverable, trustworthy and fast to operate.
designIntent.visualThesis: A focused workbench where hierarchy and system feedback matter more than decoration.

visualDirection.surfaces: quiet neutral surfaces with clear borders and deliberately elevated critical areas
visualDirection.colorIntent: semantic status colors; one restrained brand accent; code blocks use a readable syntax theme
visualDirection.typography: high-legibility sans for UI, monospace for code and identifiers, tabular numerals for metrics
visualDirection.motion: fast state feedback; avoid decorative motion in operational flows

layout.pattern: navigation + work area + optional inspector/detail panel
layout.responsive: collapse secondary panels before compressing the primary workspace

avoid: marketing-style hero inside an operational screen
decorative dashboard cards with no action

accessibility.keyboard: all navigation, tabs, menus and command actions must be keyboard reachable
accessibility.focus: persistent visible focus ring, never color-only status
accessibility.reducedMotion: no essential information conveyed only through motion

antiPatterns: syntax color used as the only meaning cue
notes: Do not make every developer product dark. Theme choice belongs to product context and user preference.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Discover capability → inspect status → configure or invoke → interpret output → diagnose and recover.
prioritize: The active developer task and current environment
Real code, request configuration, logs, output and status
Precise terminology, copyable examples and actionable errors
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Authentication scopes, permissions and destructive side effects
Whether logs, metrics and integrations are real or sample data
avoidByDefault: Marketing hero inside an operational workspace
Fake terminal output or invented service status
Generic KPI cards unrelated to a developer task
acceptanceChecks: The primary operation is reachable without a marketing preamble
Code and output are selectable and understandable without syntax color alone
Errors explain cause, location and a safe next step

compositionEscapes.when: The primary task is executing commands, editing configuration, testing APIs or running a tool.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use a focused command or editor surface with a visible environment and execution state; place the result beside or below the action and keep secondary configuration contextual.
contentRequirements: A real command, request, editor or operation
Actual output or clearly labelled sample output

compositionEscapes.when: The main task is diagnosing events, deployments, incidents or changing system behavior.
compositionEscapes.composition: Lead with a time-ordered event stream or annotated timeline, then expose filters and a selected-event detail view; summarize only measurements that answer the diagnostic question.
contentRequirements: Event source, status and filter semantics
avoid: Charts without range, units or source

compositionEscapes.when: Users alternate between learning an API or configuration and trying it immediately.
compositionEscapes.composition: Pair structured explanation with a copyable example; add a runnable console only when a real execution environment exists.
contentRequirements: Known execution environment or static-example label
Clear distinction between instructions and results
avoid: Pretending an unimplemented console is live
